name: Hindmata (Parel / Dadar)
note: Cited as one of the 'chronic waterlogging hotspots such as Parel, Hindmata cloth market and the surroundings of Milan subway'. 1-2 km from KEM, Tata Memorial and Wadia blood centres.
source: Citizen Matters, 2 Jul 2024, https://citizenmatters.in/mumbai-flood-mitigation-bmc ; coordinates: OSM Nominatim node/9739425792 (Hindmata Cinema)

name: King's Circle / Gandhi Market (Sion)
note: 'flooding in low-lying areas like Hindmata and King Circle - Gandhi Market area.' Adjacent to LTMG (Sion) Hospital.
source: Free Press Journal, 21 Aug 2025, https://www.freepressjournal.in/amp/mumbai/mumbai-flood-woes-persist-despite-bmc-mitigation-measures-rail-services-hit-near-sion-kurla ; coordinates: OSM Nominatim node/9788462273

name: Kurla (Mithi river, Kurla-Sion rail stretch / LBS Road)
note: Mithi rose above danger level and 'water accumulated on the tracks between Kurla and Sion railway stations' (FPJ 2025); 'Kurla LBS Road' listed among chronic waterlogging locations (FPJ 2026). Point = Kurla station.
source: Free Press Journal 2025 (URL above) and 2026, https://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/mumbai-monsoon-preparedness-bmc-proposes-110-crore-dewatering-pump-plan-to-tackle-flooding-at-key-waterlogging-hotspots ; coordinates: OSM Nominatim node/2663447640

name: Chunabhatti
note: Listed with Milan Subway, Masjid Bunder, Kurla LBS Road and Wadala Fire Station Road as locations of 'chronic waterlogging'.
source: Free Press Journal 2026, https://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/mumbai-monsoon-preparedness-bmc-proposes-110-crore-dewatering-pump-plan-to-tackle-flooding-at-key-waterlogging-hotspots ; coordinates: OSM Nominatim node/9788462267

name: Milan Subway (Santacruz / Vile Parle)
note: BMC dewatering plan 'to tackle chronic flooding at key Mumbai hotspots, including Milan Subway, Chunabhatti and Masjid Bunder'. Near V.N. Desai Hospital and Nanavati/Cooper blood centres.
source: Free Press Journal 2026 (URL above); Newslaundry 7 Aug 2021, https://www.newslaundry.com/2021/08/07/milan-subway-why-its-a-metaphor-for-mumbais-perpetual-flooding-problem ; coordinates: OSM Nominatim way/39532540

name: Andheri Subway
note: 'Officials say the site floods 25 to 30 times each monsoon', 'with four drains converging at the site'. Coordinate is approximate (Nominatim match for the Andheri rail-subway connection).
source: Free Press Journal 2026, https://www.freepressjournal.in/mumbai/mumbai-bmc-says-600-crore-flood-control-plan-may-only-halve-waterlogging-at-andheri-subway-permanent-fix-elusive ; coordinates: OSM Nominatim way/331815666 (approximate)

name: Masjid Bunder
note: Listed among chronic waterlogging hotspots in BMC's 2026 dewatering-pump plan. Near J.J. and G.T. hospital cluster.
source: Free Press Journal 2026 (URL above); coordinates: OSM Nominatim node/1640185006
